subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should repeated failed exec calls with the same stable failure fingerprint ignore volatile output and be allowed to trip critical/global blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix, but it deliberately changes when agent execution is stopped for repeated failed exec failures, so maintainers need to accept the availability tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec retries should stop runaway sessions.

options.title: Pause For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the session-global or fuzzy loop-detection design settled before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec retries should stop runaway sessions.
